name: MaxMindDB
tagline: Look up IP geolocation and ASN data in local MaxMind DB files
description: Query local MaxMind DB files for IP geolocation, autonomous system information, and filtered network analysis. Supports database downloads and automatic updates. This is an unofficial integration, not a MaxMind product. Requires Docker and your own MaxMind account and license key. No databases are bundled.

env.name: MAXMINDDB_MCP_LICENSE_KEY
env.description: MaxMind license key with database download access.

install.notes: Requires a running Docker engine. Downloads GeoLite2-City and GeoLite2-ASN into the persistent maxminddb-mcp-data volume. Pass the listed variables to the MCP process environment. Ask the assistant to call list_databases to check the initial download status. Lookups run locally. The upstream README also documents using existing MMDB files without MaxMind credentials.
